title: Pixel 2XL + G5 randomly disconnecting
body:
Hi all,

Recently started using xdrip with new G5 after transitioning from the G4 (had never used xdrip previously).

Using a pixel 2xl on latest Android with latest nightly build of xdrip with all battery optimisation turned off for xdrip and Bluetooth.

Basically I can get connected easily with the OB1 collector (old collector does not work at all) and things will work normally for anywhere from 2-16hrs however at some point within this time xdrip will just stop getting data and fail to connect (hangs on waiting to connect under system status). Restarting collector does not fix and the only fix is to completely restart the phone and then restart the collector after rebooting. After which it seems to reconnect and resume working normally. This happens at random times of the day (anywhere from middle of day to middle of the night)

This inherently isn't that bad however this can happen anywhere from 1-3 times per day which gets annoying and leads to a lot of missed data. 

I've tried this with every different combination of G5 debug settings and the problem persists on the latest nightly build and the most recent stable build. Been using xdrip for 4 weeks now and this is a consistent problem, the transmitter is brand new and have been through 3 sensors during that time and all behave the same way.

Just wondering if anyone else is using G5 with pixel 2xl or has experienced the same problems with their setup and has any insight because I'm at a bit of a loss.

Any assistance would be hugely appreciated.

Thanks,
Peter.

comments.body:
Hi @petermeggyesy! Unfortunately, the Pixel 2 XL seems to be having quite a lot of issues with Bluetooth, as seen [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/GooglePixel/comments/95z2n5/anyone_else_having_bluetooth_issues_with_android/), [here](https://productforums.google.com/forum/#!msg/phone-by-google/Pi-yHYArYCk/To8LDnAFAgAJ) and [here](https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/123997469). 

If I were you I'd contact Google to get a replacement phone (if still under warranty).

Not much we can do I believe...

Hi @philippebourget, thanks for your reply.

Really unfortunate to hear that, I was hoping that wouldn't be the case. Very odd seeing as I have no issues with Bluetooth headphones, smartwatch and other devices, only seems to be the G5 that fails.

Thanks anyway, really appreciate the reply.
Let's try and test the hardware. On your pixel, dial the following number: `*#*#232331#*#*`. This will perform a Bluetooth test. Let me know of the output.

Hi @philippebourget, sorry took so long to get back to you.

I've just tested this and for some reason the Bluetooth test code doesn't work. I'm able to access the 4636 test code and a few other codes but when it comes to the Bluetooth test code, once I finish dialling the number disappears and nothing happens.

Do you know if this requires root access or if there's anything else I need to enable in the phone to get this to work?

Good morning. 
It might not be compatible with your phone. I'm sorry I cannot be of any help.

If not and you are still having connectivity issues, would you mind posting in the facebook group?
